rationale: Four tools/ Python files rewrite f-string fields that only Python 3.12 parses (other quote character, or the expression bound to a local first), with no value or behaviour change; thumb_parity.py's report line prints the same text. A new checker, python_floor_syntax_check.py, parses every tracked tools/**/*.py at the 3.11 floor and runs from version-skill-check.yml and gates.sh. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
